schema.description:
Preserve the legacy named event-node contract with guarded Actor BlueprintEvent identity and actual graph readback. Supports scalar primitive inputs; object/struct/enum/container/reference/net/final/static signatures remain unsupported. An existing exact override in the selected graph is reused unchanged, including ghost state and position; no ghost promotion. Cross-graph or duplicate matches fail. No full compile/save or automatic wiring. node_id/node_guid are GUIDs; object_path is the exact node path.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Exact /Game Blueprint package/object path or simple name under /Game/Blueprints.
            event_name: Exact native event identity such as ReceiveTick; localized titles and arbitrary custom events are not inferred.
            node_position_json: JSON [x,y] with two integers from -1000000 to 1000000. Default [0,0]; JSON null preserves legacy None as origin.
            graph_name: Optional existing graph name; omitted selects the existing default event graph.
            graph_id: Optional nonzero GUID agreeing with the selected graph.
            graph_type: Optional selector; resolved graph must be an event graph.
            create_graph_if_missing: False by default; True is explicitly unsupported before dispatch.
            operation_id: Optional durable ID; replay returns its original result and uncertain work is never retried automatically.
